title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform
objective: Build an application with multiple organizations, protected resources, and shared infrastructure.
scenario: Build an application with multiple organizations, protected resources, and shared infrastructure. Build in milestones, document behavior and trade-offs, and verify each requirement with repeatable tests.

starter_files.purpose: Minimal JavaScript App Router page starter.

stretch_features: Add one targeted regression test for each critical workflow.
Measure one performance or accessibility problem before and after a change.
Document which logic belongs in a trusted server layer and what remains client-side.
tests_and_validation: Run configured lint/test commands and a production build.
Test keyboard-only navigation and direct URL refresh.
Test missing data, invalid input, request failure, and unauthorized access.
Use only synthetic records and test-mode external-service credentials.
review_method: Human review against the milestone acceptance criteria and rubric. Passing this project does not itself issue a credential.
status_note: Project brief mapped from Section D of the supplied Next.js PDF; review and complete implementation are still required.
